Searched the catalog · Frank L. Wright Usonian Desktop Globe Bronze Metallic

The Usonian Desktop Globe's sphere is 12 inches in diameter, and it sits on its hardwood base at a total height of 16 inches. It's the same kind of scale as our other 12-inch desktop globes — sized to sit nicely on a desk or credenza rather than the floor.
